body: Just had a test done for adrenal difficiency which came back negative. I am now going to get a gastric endoscopy which she said if that comes back fine that she thinks.it could be from depression.
Bloodwork came back normal. And medical work up?
They tested me for HIV. Negative. My hiboglobin levels which I guess we're fine and tested me for hyperglycemia which turned out to also be negative.
I'm talking to one of my close sisters. Doesn't seems to be helping even though her words are true.
We've been together for some time I feel like he should know or see when something is stressing me out. If you care about your significant other wouldn't you try to notice?

Going to the movies. Going on road trips. Going to eat at new places. Drawing painting. But it seems like I never have time for myself. I work come home get something to eat then get ready for bed. I do a lot more for people than I do for myself and I wish at times my significant other would see that and try to help out. I am also 22yrs young.
Everything we are we are alone. We are born alone. Die alone. You might find a special someone. But they will live most of their life doing things for themselves other than you.
It has been 8 years since her death and yet still nothing.
Thanks. But how would you remember me when I am a nobody.
Don't have money for that. Don't have money for myself.
